redfin.remarks: LOCATION! LOCATION! LOCATION! Prime Westwood Penthouse Living at its finest!Rare Mediterranean-style 2-story Penthouse, spacious with exceptional privacy, and glimpses of the Hollywood sign and mountains, set among mature Jacaranda trees on a quiet street. Distinctive two-level layout with separate floor entrances. Soaring cathedral ceilings with unique architectural details, arched window, hardwood floors, marble & stone fireplaces upstairs and downstairs. Features central A/C, a wet-bar, plantation shutters throughout, French doors with two large west-facing balconies up to state retrofit standards. Earthquake insurance included in HOA fee, in well-maintained building. Freshly painted inside and out, updated elevator and roofing. This move-in ready 3-bedroom, 3-bath home features a generous master suite with its own private balcony , fireplace, walk-in closet, and spa-like en-suite bath on a floor of its own with a private entrance!. Features many new kitchen appliances including new LG fridge, and a side-by-side in-unit laundry, and walk-in pantry. Lots and lots of closet space!Security parking in garage with side-by-side parking spaces and two storage cabinets. Garage also includes guest parking spaces. Beautiful courtyard building with a trickling fountain, north of Santa Monica Blvd, south of Wilshire. Minutes to UCLA, prestigious Century City Westfield Mall, Holmby Hills Park, L. A. Country Club, Warner Brothers Sound Studios, Santa Monica Beach, easy freeway access, and top schools.
